## ltk loadout

Print the context, commands, hooks and MCP servers ltk contributes to a session

### Synopsis

loadout prints the ctxloom loadout ltk contributes — a document with the RUN
bundle a session consumes and the typed INIT section setup consumes — for
ctxloom to seed under the source ref ctxloom:companion@ltk, once the companion
is registered (ctxloom companion add).

ctxloom execs `ltk loadout --format yaml` and parses the document it
prints.

```
ltk loadout [flags]
```

### Examples

```
  ltk loadout
```

### Options

```
      --format string   output format: yaml (the loadout document) (default "yaml")
  -h, --help            help for loadout
```

### Options inherited from parent commands

```
      --write-upgrades   Persist in-memory upgrades of older-format files (a config's old file is kept as <file>.bak; version-controlled project content keeps none, git holds it)
```
